title.en: Compassionate bedside care with mixed feedback

text.en: Clients who visited for complex care or difficult end-of-life moments praise vet Syd and receptionist Tony for their empathy and support. However, one reviewer felt strongly dissatisfied with the clinic's ethics and commercial focus, presenting a sharp contrast to the positive reviews.

Pet owners frequently highlight how gently and respectfully animals are treated during serious illnesses and farewell visits. Clients appreciate that veterinary staff ensure dogs remain comfortable and cared for during emotional procedures, creating a safe and dignified environment.

Families commend the practice for helpful guidance and clear reassurance when navigating tough decisions or emergency referrals. Reviewers note that staff stay in close touch throughout diagnostic steps, keeping owners informed and supported at every stage of their visit.

q.en: Where is Cara Veterinary Clinic Cabra located?

a.en: The clinic is situated beside the Phoenix Park Gate on North Circular Road in Cabra, Dublin 7.

q.en: Does the Cabra clinic assist with end-of-life care?

a.en: Yes, clients express gratitude for the team's compassionate and dignified support during euthanasia and final appointments.

q.en: What are the consultation hours at this branch?

a.en: The Cabra branch runs evening clinics Monday through Friday (except Wednesdays) and Saturday morning sessions.

q.en: Can emergency surgery be arranged through this practice?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that the vet guided them through necessary diagnostic investigations and arranged referrals for urgent surgery.
